# Superior Taekwondo

> A World Taekwondo (WT) club in North West Auckland, Helensville — Olympian-coached Tiny Tigers, General, Fitness, Poomsae, and Competition classes.

## About

Superior Taekwondo is a World Taekwondo (WT) club in North West Auckland, run by Andrea Kilday (2016 Rio Olympian, 3rd Dan, WT Level 2 coach). The club's slogan is "Constructing Champions".

Programmes:
- Tiny Tigers (kids from age 4)
- General (teens and adults)
- Fitness
- Poomsae
- Competition Team / Performance Pathway squad

Classes run six days a week. First class is free.

## Location & Contact

Helensville dojang: 94 Mill Road, Helensville 0875, Auckland, New Zealand

Service area: North West Auckland — Kumeū, Huapai, Waimauku, Kaukapakapa, Riverhead, Westgate, Muriwai, Parakai and the Kaipara coast.

Phone: 027 520 1613
Email: superiorfitnessnz@gmail.com

## Pricing

- One session/week: $30/week
- Unlimited: $40/week
- Sign-up fee: $25
- 10-week term: $300 (one/week) or $400 (unlimited)
- 10-session concession card: $285 (valid five months)
- Sibling discounts available
- First class is free
